name: tui-kit-example
description: Example mod that copies in the tui-kit and its adapters, and draws every kit component in a pane and the status badge in a band.

screenReaderOff.title: I use no screen reader
screenReaderOff.description: Declare that you use no screen reader, so decoration such as the meter bar is drawn.

panesDrawForScreenReader.title: Panes draw for my screen reader
panesDrawForScreenReader.description: Open panes even when a screen reader is on. Off: the panes are skipped and their plain text is written to the transcript instead.
